content.text: `ngc` now reports no errors. I wrote a migration script on top of `parseTemplate` and ran it over all 120 affected components. It covered every `<app-pill>` in both inline and `templateUrl` templates. The script updated `disableTooltip`, `variant` and `label` as specified. It added `PillTonePipe` (import and `imports` entry) wherever a non-literal `variant` needed the `pillTone` pipe. I left the library files, `<app-card>`, and `<app-pill-legacy>` alone. I spot-checked two components (`feature-1` and `feature-104`) by eye; the rest are covered only by the clean `ngc` run.
